name: Eternal extends Accelerated Recovery by 6 sec and Decomposition by 3 sec (#3094)
contract: Eternal 706777 carries two SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_DURATION (1): EffectBasePoints 5999 with EffectSpellClassMask word1 bit 0x10000000, and EffectBasePoints 2999 with word1 bit 0x80000, which resolve to +6000 and +3000 with DieSides 1 and match the tooltip "Increases the duration of your Accelerated Recovery by $/1000;s1 sec and Decomposition by $/1000;s2 sec." Accelerated Recovery's level-80 rank 501778 has SpellFamilyFlags word1 268435456 and DurationIndex 8 (SpellDuration.dbc row 8 = 15000ms); Decomposition's level-80 rank 802597 has word1 524288 and DurationIndex 86 (21000ms). Native path only: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod and Aura::CalcMaxDuration, which applies SPELLMOD_DURATION; SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod deliberately skips the IsAffectedBySpellMods() attribute gate for SPELLMOD_DURATION, so Accelerated Recovery's AttributesEx3 0x80 does not block it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Accelerated Recovery keeps its 15 sec duration without the talent
Accelerated Recovery lasts 21 sec with the talent
